messages:
Maya (Marketing): Quick heads-up — AtlasTech agreed to do a customer interview for the launch post. Targeting next Wed for publish. Who can own interview capture + getting the quote approvals?
Priya (Content): I can run the interview and write the draft. Need a two-week lead for legal clearance tho.
Jules (Product): Can we lock the feature screenshots and a short usage stat from their pilot? need exact phrasing for the PR quote.
Ethan (Sales): FYI AtlasTech is a new AE-sourced win — inbound leads should route to Field Sales > AE team. Can we add a CTA in the post to route to /sales/atlas?
Maya (Marketing): Good call. Priya, pls include a small routing paragraph. Also need to confirm if they want embargoed publish.
Priya (Content): Proposed interview slots: Tue 10am PT or Wed 2pm PT. Prefer Wed (more time to prep). 
Maya (Marketing): Wed 2pm PT works for me. @Ravi can you run the quote/usage checklist?
LegalBot: Automated checklist generated:
- Consent form (signed)
- Exact quote redact/approval by customer
- Logo usage rights
- Embargo window noted
(see attached checklist link)
Jules (Product): For the quote I suggest this starter line — "Redwood's inference reduced our per-call latency by ~40%" — but don't publish until customer OKs the number.
Priya (Content): I'll ask them to confirm numbers on the call. For efficiency, sharing a quick consent snippet for them to sign before publish:
```
AtlasTech provides Redwood Inference permission to publish quotes, logomarks, and a one-time case study. AtlasTech confirms accuracy of provided metrics.
```
Maya (Marketing): +1. Also we need a transcript and a short 60s highlight clip for socials. Ops, please record.
Ethan (Sales): Routing: When the post goes live, can marketing trigger the lead webhook to /api/lead/atlas-launch and tag source=post? That way AE team picks up fast.
Jules (Product): I'll add the screenshot folder to the shared drive post-interview. Priya, can you get a signed PDF of consent within 48hrs?
Priya (Content): Yep. I'll send the consent via DocuSign right after the call.
Ravi (Legal): Quick redlines for the quote: remove comparative percent if they can't confirm; prefer phrasing "reduced latency in our tests". Also, need a clause for anonymized attribution if they prefer.
Maya (Marketing): Noted. Priya, flag any number uncertainty during recording and ping me.
Priya (Content): Will do. Draft show-run for recording:
- 0:00 intro + context (Maya)
- 1:30 product challenge (AtlasTech)
- 4:00 demo/usage details (Jules)
- 7:00 metrics/impact (AtlasTech)
- 9:00 legal consent confirmation and signoff
- 10:00 wrap
Maya (Marketing): Looks good. @Ravi can you pre-approve the template quote language so we can close quickly after the call?
Ravi (Legal): I'll pre-approve the following conditional phrasing: "[Customer] reported latency reductions in our benchmarked runs that aligned with internal expectations." Use only after customer confirms in writing.
Priya (Content): Great — scheduling call now. Sending invite to AtlasTech + DocuSign. Will capture recording and rough transcript, then drop draft in #marketing-drafts for review.
Maya (Marketing): Thanks team. After legal OK and signed consent, we'll schedule the launch post + 60s social clip. ETA: publish next Wed EOD pending approvals. :rocket:
LegalBot: Consent form status: pending (invite sent). Reminder in 24h if not completed.
Ethan (Sales): Will standby to add routing webhook once marketing gives greenlight.
Priya (Content): Call scheduled Wed 2pm PT — invite sent. I'll ping here with the draft within 24hrs post-call.
Maya (Marketing): Awesome — closing loop. :thumbsup:
